'''2002 Alderaan Regionals''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG regional on 18 May 2002. [[Peter Nordstrom]] won. [[Clayton Atkin]] finished 2nd (3–1, lost the final duel) with a [[Dark]] [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]] list (''Atkins’ Alderaan 2nd Place TDIGWATT'').<ref name="dt-23438">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23438 Atkins’ Alderaan 2nd Place TDIGWATT], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 20 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23438/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23438/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009162620/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23438/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 18 May 2002
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Peter Nordstrom]]
